BEATS consensus on OOS rank: debuted-KM ridge Spearman 0.341 vs 0.295 (edge +0.046, widened by adding n_milb_seasons +0.010), holds/grows on recent 2019-2023 cohorts (era_split_debuted). 2026-06-22 audit: xFV wins pooled + 4/6 archetypes + every FV tier + every era + every position group; trails consensus only on HS-arms / intl-bats (youngest, lowest-track-record). REJECTED OOS (committed losses): youth*production interaction, decimal age (vs integer baseball-age), signing bonus + draft slot (redundant with consensus FV), level_rank, prod_trend, fv_trend, peak_obp/iso, iso_rel. STRUCTURAL alternatives also tested + REJECTED 2026-06-22 (forward-chained, same folds): two-part P(MLB)xE(WAR|MLB) (marginal full-pool Spearman, costs AUC, ties flagship), monotonic LightGBM + ridge/GBM stack (worse on hitter flagship 0.30/0.32 vs 0.33 -- overfits at n~400/cohort), confidence-weighted shrinkage toward consensus (no change). Conclusion: ridge is at the DATA'S rank ceiling; further gains need NEW data (historical Statcast/Stuff+, which we lack pre-~2023), not more modeling. The misses are irreducible variance (xFV right on 53% of its disagreements w/ consensus). CONDITIONAL POWER also REJECTED 2026-06-22 (the Bobby-Witt power-star miss): realized-in-games power, level-weighted (iso_x_level/iso_upper/peak_iso_x_level) + contact-paired (iso_x_hit/iso_x_contact), all FAILED OOS (best debuted-km -0.0016; replacing tool_speed cost -0.014) -- third independent confirmation (raw iso -> peak iso -> conditional) that game power does not earn a place; the power-star miss is the accepted cost of the population-level power-overpricing correction. THRESHOLD-GATED POWER + CREATIVE COHORT-SLICING also REJECTED 2026-06-22 (per-year-robustness gate added: a pooled pass only counts if positive in >=3/4 forward-chained folds): hit/obp/contact-gated power (iso_gh50/55/60, iso_gobp, iso_gk, pwrtool_gh55, double-gates) = 4th power rejection (best stack +0.0036 pooled but NEGATIVE in 2022+2023 = a 2020-21 artifact); level-weighted production (obp_x_level/k_x_level/obp_upper, add+replace) rejected; 23 creative slices (FV-tier mid-band, age-band x production, up-the-middle x production, breakout prod_trend x level, reliability/exposure weighting, source-disagreement + safe-floor composites) all rejected -- every pooled-passer was a 2020-21 fold artifact that reverses on the freshest cohorts (the level_rank/milb_missing data-vintage fingerprint). The lean hitter set is firmly at its rank ceiling; interactions of already-present linear terms only dilute the regularized ridge. Genuine further lift needs NEW data, not new slicing. Trails on full-pool + MAE (more spread). Live board gated on a pro track record; whole site backgraded (graduates/lingering) onto the live grade scale. Provisional until more cohorts resolve. XFV FEATURE EXPERIMENTS (2026-06-23, owner ask: improve cohorts / pitchers / level-weighting): tested SP/RP role split (pos_prem), AA/A+ per-level production columns, age*level, explicit K-BB%, level-jump, obp*age - forward-chained on the source_backtest per-archetype AUC + xfv_eval Spearman/MAE. RESULT: NULL, none robustly beat the tuned model (committed loss). pos_prem read +0.023 sum AUC (College arms +0.015) but Spearman was FLAT (0.2162->0.2162) + MAE worse -> within the ~+/-0.01 per-cohort AUC NOISE FLOOR (proven: hitter-only feature changes moved pitcher cohort AUCs). level_jump clearly HURT (College bats -0.046). FINDINGS: (1) AA is the single most WAR-predictive level (hitters conditional ridge +0.76, pitchers +0.29) yet explicit AA columns add nothing - the model already captures it (AA = modal final pre-decision level). (2) Int'l bats is the lone cohort consensus still beats (xFV 0.746 vs 0.782 AUC); not fixable from MiLB-stat features (scouts price young low-level projection the stats can't). SHIPPED a DSL LABELING BUGFIX (milb_history: the cached StatsAPI league name is 'DSL' not 'Dominican', so the old substring check folded ALL DSL into CPX and DSL norms were unavailable; now splits DSL/VSL vs CPX + re-derives level on cached reads). Model-NEUTRAL (hitter Spearman +/-0.001; AUC HS arms +0.014 / int'l bats -0.008, net ~flat) - shipped as a CORRECTNESS fix since correct level norms benefit every MiLB-norm surface. HIGH-END TAIL FIX REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can a tail fix improve xFV at the high end, ex. Bobby Witt Jr.'): NO - committed as a loss. Forward-chained diagnosis (tools/xfv_tail_lab.py, the SAME OOS protocol as this eval) shows the top tier is already OVER-predicted vs realized first-6yr WAR, not under: FV>=55 hitters predict 10.4 vs realized 7.7 (bias +2.7), pitchers 6.0 vs 3.5 (bias +2.5) - a winner's-curse/attrition artifact that is INVISIBLE in-sample, so no correction fit on train transfers to it. And rank is invariant to any monotone tail transform by construction, so a tail fix cannot move the flagship rank gate either. Tested forward-chained, all LOSSES, none shipped: tail expansion (worsens FV55+ calibration), tail compression (no transfer - collapses to identity), global per-fold linear recalibration (worsens FV55+ MAE/bias - it is MSE-optimal for the bulk, not the bimodal tail), high-FV prior-anchoring lambda dip (rank delta hit -0.001 / pit +0.0002 = noise). The genuine high-end gap is within-elite-tier DISCRIMINATION (FV55+ realized spreads far wider than predictions; within-cohort slope ~2.0) - a new-discriminating-feature problem, NOT a magnitude transform; consistent with xFV at the trainable-data ceiling. Harness kept: tools/xfv_tail_lab.py. PROJECTED-ETA FEATURE REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can projected ETA improve xFV'): NO - committed loss. Result: blend rho 0.2625 -> 0.2787 (+0.016), within-tier 0.118 -> 0.131, FV-45 fringe 0.107 -> 0.122; hitters UNCHANGED (WAG has signal there, lam stays 0.9). Leakage-free forward-chained selection confirms +0.017; 0.66 is the only move whose player-bootstrap CI stays strictly positive (P>0=0.98) -- the originally-tested 0.85-0.90 oversold (CI crosses zero AND degrades the fringe). New leakage-free experiment harness: tools/xfv_ml_lab.py (swaps model class / features / target / objective / lambda on the shipped forward-chained protocol; reproduces baselines exactly). XFV FEATURE EXPERIMENTS (2026-06-23, owner ask: improve cohorts / pitchers / level-weighting): tested SP/RP role split (pos_prem), AA/A+ per-level production columns, age*level, explicit K-BB%, level-jump, obp*age - forward-chained on the source_backtest per-archetype AUC + xfv_eval Spearman/MAE. RESULT: NULL, none robustly beat the tuned model (committed loss). pos_prem read +0.023 sum AUC (College arms +0.015) but Spearman was FLAT (0.2162->0.2162) + MAE worse -> within the ~+/-0.01 per-cohort AUC NOISE FLOOR (proven: hitter-only feature changes moved pitcher cohort AUCs). level_jump clearly HURT (College bats -0.046). FINDINGS: (1) AA is the single most WAR-predictive level (hitters conditional ridge +0.76, pitchers +0.29) yet explicit AA columns add nothing - the model already captures it (AA = modal final pre-decision level). (2) Int'l bats is the lone cohort consensus still beats (xFV 0.746 vs 0.782 AUC); not fixable from MiLB-stat features (scouts price young low-level projection the stats can't). SHIPPED a DSL LABELING BUGFIX (milb_history: the cached StatsAPI league name is 'DSL' not 'Dominican', so the old substring check folded ALL DSL into CPX and DSL norms were unavailable; now splits DSL/VSL vs CPX + re-derives level on cached reads). Model-NEUTRAL (hitter Spearman +/-0.001; AUC HS arms +0.014 / int'l bats -0.008, net ~flat) - shipped as a CORRECTNESS fix since correct level norms benefit every MiLB-norm surface. HIGH-END TAIL FIX REJECTED (2026-06-25, owner asked 'can a tail fix improve xFV at the high end, ex. Bobby Witt Jr.'): NO - committed as a loss. Forward-chained diagnosis (tools/xfv_tail_lab.py, the SAME OOS protocol as this eval) shows the top tier is already OVER-predicted vs realized first-6yr WAR, not under: FV>=55 hitters predict 10.4 vs realized 7.7 (bias +2.7), pitchers 6.0 vs 3.5 (bias +2.5) - a winner's-curse/attrition artifact that is INVISIBLE in-sample, so no correction fit on train transfers to it. Tested forward-chained, all LOSSES, none shipped: tail expansion (worsens FV55+ calibration), tail compression (no transfer - collapses to identity), global per-fold linear recalibration (worsens FV55+ MAE/bias - it is MSE-optimal for the bulk, not the bimodal tail), high-FV prior-anchoring lambda dip (rank delta hit -0.001 / pit +0.0002 = noise). models.notes: SHIPPED 2026-06-30 (/mlbstats/ Bullpen Leaderboards), FULL validation. Forward-chained OOS 2018-2025 (ex-2020): REM+ predicts next-year RA9 at rho 0.236 vs raw FIP 0.211, ERA 0.090, raw WPA 0.106; bootstrap CI on the rho gap beats ERA (lo95 +0.088), beats raw WPA (lo95 +0.068), and edges its raw-FIP parent (lo95 +0.001) - so the empirical-Bayes shrinkage + reliever-pool anchoring earn their place. TWO-NUMBER design EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED: the leverage-weighted variant bake-off (REM+_lev = 100+(REM+-100)*(1+d*(gmLI-1))) is monotone-WORSE in d (optimal damping d=0: rho 0.236 at d=0 -> 0.227 at d=1.0), so folding gmLI in only hurts forward prediction (gmLI is manager-assigned, not repeatable skill; Moore 2011). YET the MARKET CHECK (271 matched RP FA signings, data/fa_archive.json) shows leverage-weighted REM+ correlates with AAV slightly BETTER (0.516) than pure (0.508): teams PAY for leverage. Conclusion (Rosen 2026): leverage is a price/deployment layer, not a talent layer -> kept OUT of the 100-scale REM+, surfaced in separate Impact columns (gmLI/WPA/WPA-LI/SD-MD). STABILIZATION: split-half REM+ rho rises with sample (0.18 @50-100 BF, 0.34 @100-150, 0.42 @150-250; relievers are genuinely volatile), qualifying at 100 BF sits at the knee. DATA self-computed from the StatsAPI winProbability feed (gmLI/WPA; FanGraphs 403-blocked), backfilled 2018-2025 via tools/backfill_win_prob.py (~17k games cached). v1 anchors on FIP not xFIP (xFIP needs a fly-ball walk). Bullpen+ = relief-IP-weighted REM+ rollup (leverage out) + a separate leverage-deploy column. Harness tools/rem_plus_backtest.py. X-S4 (Statcast xwOBA-allowed) TESTED + REJECTED 2026-07-06: over 6 Savant year-pairs (592 starter pairs), xwOBA-allowed forward-predicts next-year RA9 at rho 0.377 vs FIP 0.382 (a 0.5x/0.5x blend 0.384, gap vs FIP lo95 -0.053, CI spans 0), so contact-quality-allowed is redundant with what FIP already strips out; the FIP core stays. (Unlike hitters, where xwOBA strips the batter own BABIP luck and DID beat actual wOBA -> shipped xHEM+.) HARNESS-V2 RESTAMP COMPANION (2026-07-15, tools/rem_plus_lab.py): data/rem_plus_eval_restamp.json re-measures the shipped forward block on the lab pool (ex-openers, complete-outcome-season pairs only, unrounded rem_plus_raw) under BOTH conventions - v1 rho 0.2374 vs raw FIP 0.211 (gap lo95 +0.0023) and v2 (within-outcome-season z target, player-clustered season-stratified bootstrap) rho 0.2374 vs FIP 0.2172 (gap lo95 -0.0043; clustered CIs are wider by design and the shipped verdict STANDS per the pre-declared interpretation rules). Our own mixture Poisson-binomial model computes a per-player version from the outcome-bucket distribution; under the v47 realized (bust-heavy) WAR anchors it runs below the published tiers, so it is shown as a diagnostic only.
